messages:
Omar: Morning — quick preflight before the cut window at 14:00 UTC. What’s the train status, any last-minute cherries or blockers?

Maya: did a light smoke on canary, looks okay overall. One flaky e2e failed intermittently (filed #5821) — rerunning that job now.

Jae: working on a cherry-pick for the runtime perf regression: PR #6824. Backport target release-0.9.1. Small diff but needs perf test on dedicated infra.

Carmen: PDE tests are green, packaging job on ubuntu-latest hit pbuilder timeouts earlier — I retried, watch for another failure.

Priya: oncall FYI — saw a short capacity dip in eu-west yesterday, autoscaler kicked and there were ~60s of 503s. Incident note posted in #incidents. No ongoing impact.

Maya: blocker: we can't merge 6824 until the dedicated perf job is green. Jae, can you trigger a rerun with the dedicated tag and request a manual canary?

Jae: rerun submitted: `ci retry --job=perf-dedicated --pr=6824`. Also adding a canary request. pinging @eng-runtime for a quick review.

Ben: I can review now, will do a quick pass and handle backport if it looks sane.

Omar: note for cut list: if 6824 lands, include it; otherwise hold for next train. Please add label `cherry/cut-2026-03-17` when ready. :train:

deploy-bot: canary deployment queued for release-2026-03-17 at 13:40 UTC (id: canary-2071123).

Carmen: left a tiny nit on #6842 release notes, not blocking.

Ben: approved 6824 and 6842, created backports: release-0.9.1/pr-6824-backport and release-0.9.1/pr-6842-backport.

Maya: rolling canary now — watch the logs: https://logs.redwood.example/canary/2071123 (tailing for errors and tail latency).

Priya: monitoring infra metrics (cpu, p95/p99). No change to tail latency so far, error rate flat. Will update if anything spikes.

Jae: re: cherry-pick commands for whoever needs them:
```
# example cherry-pick workflow
git checkout release-0.9.1
git fetch origin pull/6824/head:cherry-6824
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
```

Omar: thanks everyone. Final check-in at T-20m before cut. If anything else is blocking, put it here — otherwise we'll proceed with the scheduled cut. :thumbsup:
